newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy to acquire service rig company.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy to acquire service rig company.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said Wednesday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Brooks Well Servicing Inc, which owns 32 service rigs and ancillary equipment.

Under the deal, Key Energy will issue about one million shares of its common stock to Brooks Well's parent, Hunt Oil Co of Dallas. As a result, Hunt Oil will own about 8.8 percent of Key Energy's common stock.
The acquisition is expected to be completed by December 15.
Brooks Well will continue to operate under its own name, incorporating the fleet of 13 rigs that Key Energy currently operates in East Texas.
